blastRadius: The shared-header refactor is the real risk: LanguageSelector, its icons and the setLocale action move out of app/login/ into app/_components/ and app/_actions/, so /login imports change and a mistake there breaks the already-shipped and already-tested login screen (F001). setLocale's revalidatePath widens from /login to the layout scope, which touches cache behaviour on every route that reads the locale cookie. Reading cookies() in the homepage opts / into dynamic rendering, so the page is no longer statically prerendered. playwright.config.ts gains two testMatch entries; a regex mistake silently stops existing suites from running. proxy.ts is deliberately NOT modified — / already falls through untouched.
contracts: clarifications.md is the authoritative, non-reopenable decision record for this screen
Dictionary (lib/i18n/messages/vi.ts) is the shared i18n type: adding a key obliges both vi and en, enforced at compile time
resolveLocale / getDictionary / setLocale signatures are inherited from F001_Login and must not change shape, only location
MoMorph design data is authoritative for every visual value; the frame image wins over stale spec rows
e2e-red-first: the tester owns e2e/homepage*.spec.ts and playwright.config.ts; implementation agents never edit tests to make them pass
Next.js 16: next/image uses preload, not the deprecated priority prop; cookies() and page props are async
